Hi Sarah —

Good catch on the CET/CEST callout. For clarity: the dates I listed were converted with local DST in mind, but I should have spelled the offsets out. For the week of Mar 29–Apr 4:
- Frankfurt will be CEST (UTC+2) starting Sun Mar 28.
- US East will be EDT (UTC-4) starting Sun Mar 14 (so already in effect).

That means: Option A (Tue Mar 30, 16:00 GMT / 18:00 CEST) — apologies, I see Olga’s note used a quick conversion. To align with Sarah’s preference for morning Frankfurt, here are two alternative morning windows that keep US east still feasible: 

- Alt 1: Tue Mar 30, 08:30 PT / 11:30 ET / 16:30 UTC / 18:30 CEST (later than your preference)
- Alt 2: Wed Mar 31, 07:30 PT / 10:30 ET / 15:30 UTC / 17:30 CEST (fits within 09:30–11:00 CEST if we shift to 09:30 CEST -> 02:30 PT / 05:30 ET, which is painful for US)

Given the overlap constraints, our recommendation is to hold the session at 09:30–10:15 CEST (Frankfurt local) on Wed Mar 31 and record for the West Coast. Proposed calendar time for that is: Wed Mar 31, 09:30 CEST / 03:30 ET / 00:30 PT — which is unfortunately early for the West Coast. If that’s unacceptable, we can do 11:00 CEST / 07:00 ET / 04:00 PT and plan an async recording.

We’re happy to adapt — do you have a hard constraint on earliest Frankfurt time?

(Attachment: Redwood-demo-UTC-cheatsheet.pdf)

Thanks,
